subject: [hw] DONE D01 rev 2: J02 JPEG-routing facts merged; V15 PKHTB note
body:
Rev 2 only adds verified facts to FACTS.md (no code change). bash gpu/hwcodec/facts/run_tests.sh still ends with: N2TEST D01 PASS 32/32.

Merged from hw-j02 (jpeg/ROUTING.md, all [V] with unslid addresses): no stock binary builds the "jpeg" FourCC (0 sites); CMPhoto has 3 VTCompressionSessionCreate sites and the codec type is a caller field; CMPhoto queries IOKit "AppleJPEGDriver" and 50 of its stubs land in AppleJPEG.framework; ImageIO does not link VideoToolbox; AVFCapture has 0 VT session creates; CMCapture has exactly 1 (BWVideoCompressorNode); EnableHardwareAcceleratedVideoEncoder / RequireHardwareAcceleratedVideoEncoder cstrings located; and the correction that -[BWIntermediateJPEGCompressor _setupJPEGCompressionOptions] does not exist in this cache. FACTS.md rows 7.5-7.12 and 7.13/7.14 renumbered.

Also added hw-v15s llvm-mc fact (pkhtb with no shift canonicalises to pkhbt) as row 4.12, renumbering the IT row to 4.13.

FACTS.md is now 8 sections / 105 fact rows. Nothing else changed; still no phone, no commit, no publish. Available for review findings.
